matches.label: broader
matches.rationale: Asks for the dataset's dimensions (time period, region, sex) plus their presentational order, with no format-independence condition.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Asks which dimensions each observation needs, but only for a Data Cube qb:DataSet rather than a format-independent dataset description.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Asks for each observation's values of its identifying dimensions, observation-level data rather than a dataset-level description of the dimensions.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Concerns the dataset metadata defining dimension values unambiguously, which overlaps with but is not the same as describing the dimensions.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Covers two of the attributes (unit, measured/estimated status) as per-observation values, not a format-independent description of the dataset's attributes.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Covers only the unit-of-measure attribute, as per-observation values.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Asks which attributes are required for qb:Observations, a Data Cube-specific subset of the attributes.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Concerns flagging attributes as required or optional for observations, an aspect of attribute description rather than the attributes themselves.

matches.label: equivalent
matches.rationale: Asks for the unit of measurement of the observed values (years is only an example).

matches.label: broader
matches.rationale: Asks for the unit of measurement of an observation plus whether its value is measured or estimated.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Says unit of measure can be attached once at dataset level, a modelling option overlapping with stating the dataset's unit.

matches.label: broader
matches.rationale: Temporal coverage of any dataset includes the start (and end) of the covered period.

matches.label: broader
matches.rationale: Temporal coverage of any dataset includes the end (and start) of the covered period.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Update frequency of a dataset is related to, but not the same as, the periodicity of a time series.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Asks for a dataset's thematic classification in general, without the EU data theme vocabulary or the Eurostat theme mapping.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Concerns representing dataset themes as concepts of a declared theme taxonomy, not classifying by EU data theme with a Eurostat mapping.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Lists a dataset's subject among core metadata; overlaps only with the classification aspect, without EU data theme or mapping.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Concerns a dataset's single associated data structure definition rather than linking an RDF distribution to the DSD it follows.

matches.label: broader
matches.rationale: Lists a dataset's issued and modified dates among other core metadata, without the time-of-day precision for multiple daily publication.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Release date of a catalogue rather than of datasets, without time-of-day precision.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Modification date of a catalogue rather than of datasets, without time-of-day precision.

matches.label: partial
matches.rationale: Concerns the meaning of dataset release and modification dates, not recording them to the time of day.
